question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 7
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 7

**Formula used:**

Order of operations: BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 7

⇒ (-9) - (-60 ÷ -15) + (-2 × 7)

⇒ (-9) - (4) + (-14)

⇒ -9 - 4 - 14

⇒ -27

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
